info.name: EIWAMS API
info.description: Employee Identity & Workplace Access Management System API (v1). Local runs use Auth:Mode=DevHeader; switch users with the X-User-Id header (1 System Admin, 2 HR, 3 Manager, 4 Security, 5 Facility Admin, 6 Reception, 7 Employee (Esha), 8 Auditor). Run folders top to bottom: later requests reuse ids captured by earlier ones.
